detail.title: Autonomous Identification of Research Gaps in Open-Ended Learning
detail.summary: Autonomous learning systems, by generating their own goals, can transcend current limitations defined by ground-truth dependent datasets. By leveraging intrinsic curiosity and self-generated tasks, agents can autonomously discover novel research frontiers.
detail.reason: Integrating evidence on autonomous knowledge work frontiers to revise the project's foundational scope.

detail.title: Autonomous Research Gap Identification and Preference Formation Synthesis
detail.summary: This cycle advances the autonomous identification of research gaps by incorporating evidence on transcending structured, ground-truth-dependent learning in favor of curiosity-driven, open-ended inquiry. The project on path dependence in preference formation remains active, maintaining focus on how adaptive sequences shape agent values.
